text:
lina: Heads-up — prepping the marketplace onboarding for SI customer tomorrow. Need driver/CUDA/ROCm pin decision and a hotfix path if the quant kernel shows up in canary.
raj: Thanks. What pins are we proposing?
lina: Proposal (from infra):
```
CUDA: 12.3.1
NVIDIA driver: 535.86
ROCm: 5.7
Kernel: 5.15.x tested
```
emily: We ran smoke on the image in us-west-2 with that stack, no regressions on basic perf tests. One infra note: a small perf delta on A100 80GB with batch>8 for long seqs.
kevin: For marketplace packaging we should include a fallback image tag that uses the previous kernel/driver combo. Consumers can opt in to fallback if they see perf drop.
lina: Good call. Can we get a fallback tag named `redwood/mkt-image:v1.2-fallback`?
emily: I can build that today. Will also add a startup probe that fails fast if the quant kernels aren't registering.
aws_jane: Partner side: AWS SI asked for a canary window 10pm-2am PT and daily health reports. They need commit signoff by EOD.
raj: Signoff checklist:
- final pins agreed
- fallback image pushed
- canary schedule confirmed with SI
- rollback playbook (steps + contacts)
- announcement copy for marketplace listing
kevin: I'll draft the announcement blurb and include note about pinned stack and suggested upgrade path.
lina: Rollback playbook (short):
1) If canary perf/regressions -> flip traffic to fallback image in 15m
2) If persistent -> rollback model variant to quant-safe build
3) Open incident, page eng-oncall + partners oncall
(deets in doc link: https://go.redwood/marketplace-onboard)
emily: Build status: fallback image queued, ETA 40m. I’ll tag it `v1.2-fallback` when done.
aws_jane: SI confirms the 10pm-2am PT window and will run their workload. They want an on-call number to call during the window.
lina: On-call is eng-oncall rotation, pager is in the doc. Raj, can you be secondary during the window?
raj: Yep I can take secondary.
kevin: Announcement blurb ready; sending to partners for signoff now.
deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline started for `redwood/mkt-image:v1.2` -> canary (us-west-2). CI tests passed: 38/38.
lina: Perfect. Final ask to partners: please ack pins + canary schedule by 17:00 PT. If no ack, we default to these pins and proceed. :thumbsup:
aws_jane: Ack from SI side — pins & schedule OK. Will share runbook notes after first canary hour.
emily: Fallback image pushed and tagged at 1748213380.
raj: All set on our side. Ready for canary.
lina: Thanks everyone — will monitor first 30m and report back.
